# S121 — Add slicer setup-git to configure the render merge driver on any clone

**Findings:**  · **Size:**  · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

S118 makes `slicer init` print the two per-clone `git config` lines that turn on the `slicer-generated` render merge driver, but a clone of an existing project never runs `init` -- that is exactly the case where the driver is unconfigured and every merge leaves ROADMAP stale. The setup then lives only in the docs. A dedicated command prints the lines on any clone and is scriptable.

## Files

- `src/slicer/cli.py` (a new read-only `setup-git` command and its registration; reuse `_render_driver_setup`)
- `tests/` for the command
- `README.md` and `docs/getting-started.md` to point clones at it

## Failing tests

1. `slicer setup-git` prints both `git config merge.slicer-generated.*` lines and exits 0.
2. It runs with no project present (reads no `.slicer/`), and slicer never executes `git config` (the vcs allowlist is unchanged).
3. `slicer setup-git --json` returns the commands as data (a list) so a caller can eval them.

## Implement

Add a read-only `setup-git` command that prints the two config lines, reusing the `_render_driver_setup` helper from S118. It needs no project state, so it must not call `store.load`. Offer `--json` returning the commands as a list. Do not add `config` to the vcs allowlist. Update the docs to send a fresh clone to `slicer setup-git`.

## Check

`slicer setup-git` prints the lines and exits 0 with and without a project present; `--json` returns them as data; the suite and `slicer check` pass.
